options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create a refined ORIGINAL logo concept for the app Sahara. Its confirmed full title is "Sahara — A Palliative Care Companion". It supports people living with serious illness, their families and their doctors.
This must match its EXISTING app design: warm ivory cream backgrounds, rust-coloured controls, rich brown serif headings, gentle rounded forms, soft golden yellow panels. Warm, humane, contemporary and dignified.
Colour palette STRICTLY: background solid cream #FFF8EE, main emblem rust #B9472C, all text dark brown #382E29. Golden yellow #FFCF5C may be a very small purposeful accent. No blue, cyan, purple or green.
Style: beautiful bespoke flat vector-style brand artwork; simple strong silhouette; sophisticated generous curves; clean solid fills with absolutely no gradient, texture, 3D or drop shadow.
Composition: one centered logo lockup on a square cream canvas. Emblem in the upper middle, generous space below for the wordmark. Emblem around 32 percent of canvas width; entire lockup around 60 percent wide with airy margins.
Typography: "Sahara" large, in a warm, elegant, highly readable contemporary serif with softly bracketed serifs and moderate stroke contrast, similar to editorial serif headings in a warm care app. Natural letter spacing. Directly below, smaller but clearly readable clean sans-serif exact text "A Palliative Care Companion". Do not add any other text.
The emblem must look convincing at 32px and in a single ink colour. Deliberate optical balance and polished brand-designer craftsmanship. Avoid stock charity clip art, detailed hands/fingers, separate medical crosses, ECG lines, cancer ribbons, stars, swirls, extra decoration, badges, app mockups and grids.
One concept only. No labels, numbers or alternative versions in this image.
Concept: HELD HEART. Design one compact monocolour rust emblem that cleverly combines an open-hearted cupped palm with a heart. The broad smooth palm wraps upward around the lower edge of a softly asymmetric heart; a clean cream negative-space gap defines the embrace. Prefer two to three simple broad shapes rather than outlines. Immediately recognizable as care and support, but feel crafted and intimate rather than a conventional hospital mark.

Concept: TOGETHER. A graceful rust silhouette of two abstract adult people leaning toward and supporting one another. Two simple equal-sized circular heads and the embracing curved bodies create a subtle HEART in the cream negative space between them. Keep the figures equal in dignity; do not show a parent and baby. The whole silhouette should have the intimacy and elegance of a small sculpture, with no thin strokes and no enclosing heart border.

Concept: SAHARA EMBRACE. Design a custom bold soft S monogram in rust, formed by two broad curved supporting arms that almost join. The upper inward curve cradles a tiny heart-shaped negative space; the lower curve feels like an upturned protective palm. The result must still read as a simple balanced S before the care detail is noticed. Uncluttered, iconic, round yet sturdy. No literal fingers, human heads or extra objects. An elegant distinct brand symbol that belongs beside the serif Sahara wordmark.
